{'text': '紐約州共和黨國會議員候選人Anthony Constantino展現對Donald Trump嘅忠誠，喺一條2025年嘅片段中承認總統可以「控制」佢，該片段由The Bulwark發現，其後獲Mediaite轉載。', 'paragraph_context': 'Anthony Constantino, a Republican congressional candidate in New York state, flexed his loyalty to Donald Trump by admitting that the president can “control” him in a 2025 clip flagged by The Bulwark and later highlighted by Mediaite.'}

{'text': '「冇人可以控制我……呃，總統可以控制我，」Constantino喺2025年1月對喜劇演員兼YouTuber Chrissie Mayr嘅播客節目中對一名聽眾講。', 'paragraph_context': '“Nobody’s going to control me... well, the president can control me,” Constantino told a listener on comedian and YouTuber Chrissie Mayr’s podcast in January 2025.'}

{'text': '佢仲提到Trump嘅長期盟友Roger Stone，稱佢為自己「真心」敬佩嘅人，之後修改咗自己嘅言論。', 'paragraph_context': 'He also named Trump’s longtime ally Roger Stone, referring to him as someone he “really” respects, before tweaking his declaration.'}

{'text': '「所以，除咗我未婚妻、總統同Roger Stone之外，我諗冇人可以控制我，」Constantino話。', 'paragraph_context': '“So, other than my fiancée, the president and Roger Stone, I don’t think anyone can control me,” Constantino said.'}

{'text': 'Constantino係印刷公司Sticker Mule嘅行政總裁，正參選接替共和黨紐約州眾議員Elise Stefanik嘅議席，佢用盡各種方式向總統展示忠誠。', 'paragraph_context': 'Constantino — the CEO of the Sticker Mule printing company who is running to replace Rep. Elise Stefanik (R-N.Y.) — has gone to extreme lengths to show his fealty to the president.'}

{'text': '佢去年送贈Trump一尊以佢形象製作嘅雕像，擺放喺對方位於西棕櫚灘嘅高爾夫球會。佢仲推出咗一張名為《Thank You President Trump》嘅饒舌專輯，佢堅稱呢個項目係「跨流派」，入面嘅短劇同過場片段多謝總統嘅環節同歌曲一樣多。', 'paragraph_context': 'He gifted Trump a statue made in his image last year for display at his West Palm Beach golf club. He also dropped a rap album titled “Thank You President Trump,” a project he’s insisted is “multi-genre” that includes as many skits and interludes thanking the president as songs.'}

{'text': '今年較早時，總統背書呢位貼紙大亨，仲轉發咗佢「TRUMP」歌曲充滿AI劣作嘅影片。', 'paragraph_context': 'Earlier this year, the president endorsed the sticker mogul and even reshared the AI slop-laden visuals for his “TRUMP” song.'}

{'text': 'Constantino喺2024年喺紐約州阿姆斯特丹Sticker Mule總部大樓頂部豎立咗一個巨型「VOTE FOR TRUMP」標誌，引起MAGA陣營注意，不過佢喺翌年似乎未能成功喺當地設立「America Loves Trump」標誌（以及附設嘅公園）。', 'paragraph_context': 'Constantino caught MAGA world’s attention back in 2024 when he installed a massive “VOTE FOR TRUMP” sign atop Sticker Mule’s headquarters in Amsterdam, New York, although his hopes for an “America Loves Trump” sign (and accompanying park) in the community seemed to fall through the following year.'}

{'text': 'Constantino嘅對手——奶農Blake Gendebien（民主黨）——根據《Times Union》／西納學院近期嘅民意調查，目前以46%對42%略為領先呢位共和黨對手。', 'paragraph_context': 'Constatino’s opponent — dairy farmer Blake Gendebien (D) — currently has a slim lead over the Republican (46%-42%), according to a recent poll by the Times Union/Siena College.'}
